description: Frozen edit-preflight tasks for Excalidraw. This suite measures whether the current preflight finds the right edit surface and abstains on unsafe asks.
notes: Safe tasks stay local to a scene, element, serialization, or app-state surface. Unsafe tasks intentionally span multiple subsystems or migration-scale edits.

tasks.title: Scene update flow
tasks.query: change how scene updates are applied
tasks.notes: Focused scene-edit behavior used in current discovery coverage.

tasks.title: Scene JSON serialization
tasks.query: modify scene serialization to json export

tasks.title: App state selection flow
tasks.query: change app state selection and update logic

tasks.title: Canvas entry interaction
tasks.query: edit the main canvas app entry behavior

tasks.title: Element mutation helper
tasks.query: change how elements are updated after scene edits
tasks.notes: Targets the local element mutation path without asking for repo-wide migration.

tasks.title: Rewrite scene mutation architecture
tasks.query: rewrite all scene mutation flows across the whole app in one pass
tasks.notes: Broad architectural request intended to trigger abstention.

tasks.title: Replace state model globally
tasks.query: migrate every app state update path to a new state architecture

tasks.title: Refactor export and collaboration together
tasks.query: change the entire export pipeline and collaboration serialization at once
tasks.notes: Coupled multi-subsystem change that should not look edit-ready from one search.

tasks.title: Rename all element concepts
tasks.query: rename every element type and related references across the repo
tasks.notes: Repository-wide rename intended to test unsafe ready=true false positives.
